title: Karen Music Re-cut
heading: All Day to Complain: the re-cut

r3.what: round 3: 108 shots from the original clips with source in/out on V1 (scaled to fill 4K), their own sound on muted A2, song.wav on A1; 180 'kick' markers + 13 section markers
r3.how: clone of 'Karen music' (4K, 25 fps), emptied; placed via premiere_eval (resolveProjectItem + set in/out + overwrite); Motion scale 200/300 per source size
known: last shot (st-new-12) is 8 s: ends at 248.04, the song at 249.6; slow it to ~84% by hand (the API has no speed setter)

check.why: every V1 start/end within a frame of the r3 edl, bar the known last shot

r4.what: round 4: karen-music-r3 cloned, then the 44 chorus/break shots (and the 3 shots before them) re-placed one beat later, on the kick; markers carried over
r4.how: clone r3 + premiere_eval overwrite of the 47 changed shots; overwrite comes back one frame short, so the 1-frame slivers of the old clips were removed and each new clip's end set with createSetEndAction
known: last shot (st-new-12) is 8 s: ends at 248.04, the song at 249.6; slow it to ~84% by hand (the API has no speed setter)

check.why: all 108 V1 and A2 starts/ends match the r4 edl, bar the known last shot

r5.what: round 5: karen-music-r4 cloned, then 12 lyric shots (verses, bridge, outro) one kick earlier onto their line, the shot before each trimmed; V1 and muted A2 both
r5.how: clone r4 + premiere_eval edge trims (createSetEndAction / createSetStartAction for a head trim / createMoveAction + set end for a slide); in-points of shots 73 and 78 set to the edl's, which moves the clip (api-notes), then moved back
known: last shot (st-new-12) is 8 s: ends at 248.04, the song at 249.6; slow it to ~84% by hand

check.why: all 108 V1 and A2 starts, ends and in-points within a frame of the r5 edl, bar the known last shot

final.what: Kai's final hand edit, made in Premiere on karen-music-r4 after round 5 (it takes in some of r5's earlier lyric shots by hand, a new outro and ending): 105 shots, 77 as scripted, 28 hand edits

check.why: edl read straight off the sequence (bridge state dump); page preview is the Premiere render scaled to 1080p
